working_resolution.comment: Internal processing width; coordinates mapped back to original.

geometry.comment: Expected fovea = disc center + temporal*disc_fovea_distance + down*vertical_offset, in disc diameters (DD). Search disk radius in DD around it. Laterality inferred (see laterality.*).

laterality.comment: Disc centroid x vs FOV centroid x decides temporal side. min_margin_frac_fov guards ambiguity.

appearance.comment: Green-channel patch statistics. patch_radius_dd scales with anatomy.

vessel_sparsity.comment: Vessel-density heuristic (NOT a biomarker): inner-disk density vs outer-ring density. High outer/inner ratio favours avascular candidates.

_comment: SIH26038 Phase 4C — fovea localization baseline. ENGINEERING HEURISTICS tuned on 8 IDRiD training images only (frozen thereafter). All spatial parameters in disc-diameter (DD) units or FOV fractions — never raw pixels. Weights sum to 1.0.
